title: Agentic Commerce World: An Auditable and Verifiable Environment for Vibe Commerce
title_zh: Agentic Commerce World：面向 Vibe Commerce 的可审计、可验证环境
abstract_en: In vibe coding, people describe software in natural language and delegate implementation to AI agents. By analogy, vibe commerce allows people to express buying or selling goals in natural language and delegate the corresponding tasks to agents. Commerce, however, requires independently controlled Buyer and Merchant agents to interact in a shared market while preserving their private objectives and distinct authority. We introduce Agentic Commerce World (ACWorld), an environment for evaluating such agents across ongoing transactions. Through its Vibe Commerce Protocol (VCP), ACWorld validates agent actions before updating shared transaction state and records the resulting interactions, making agent behavior auditable and evaluation reproducible. The ACWorld Benchmark contains a 200-task capability-coverage track and a 60-task large-catalog track that searches 785,022 transactable listings. Across ten models, mean scores range from 65.9% to 85.6% and from 56.1% to 91.4%, respectively. Our analysis shows that process-level evidence is necessary: final state alone can miss evaluated errors, incomplete trajectories still retain useful process signals, and large-catalog tasks expose bottlenecks across stages.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 Agentic Commerce World（ACWorld），用于评估自然语言驱动的“vibe commerce”场景中的 AI 代理。在该范式下，用户用自然语言表达购买或销售目标，并将执行过程委托给 AI agents。与 vibe coding 不同，commerce 需要由不同主体控制的 Buyer agents 与 Merchant agents 在共享市场中交互，同时保留各自的私有目标与权限边界。ACWorld 通过 Vibe Commerce Protocol（VCP）在更新共享交易状态前验证 agent 动作，并记录交互过程，从而支持行为审计与可复现实验评估。ACWorld Benchmark 包含 200 个任务的能力覆盖评测轨道，以及 60 个任务的大规模商品目录轨道，后者涉及 785,022 个可交易 listings。对十个模型的实验显示，两条轨道的平均得分分别为 65.9%–85.6% 和 56.1%–91.4%。分析表明，仅看最终状态会漏掉部分错误；即使未完成轨迹也包含有价值的过程信号；大规模目录任务能暴露检索、决策与交易流程各阶段的瓶颈。
key_points_zh: 提出 Agentic Commerce World（ACWorld），用于评估 Buyer agents 与 Merchant agents 在共享市场中的持续交易交互。
设计 Vibe Commerce Protocol（VCP），在状态更新前验证 agent 动作，并记录完整交互轨迹，使行为可审计、评测可复现。
构建 ACWorld Benchmark：包含 200-task capability-coverage track 与 60-task large-catalog track，后者覆盖 785,022 个可交易 listings。
十个模型实验显示，不同模型在两条轨道上表现差异明显，平均得分分别为 65.9%–85.6% 与 56.1%–91.4%。
研究强调过程级证据的重要性：最终状态不足以发现所有错误，未完成轨迹仍有评估价值，大目录任务能揭示多阶段瓶颈。

llm_assessment.comment: A highly relevant agentic commerce benchmark that frames auditable buyer-merchant interactions as a concrete evaluation environment.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项高度相关的智能体电商基准工作，将可审计的买卖双方交互具体化为评测环境。
